grid.expression: SELECT TAB.NUNOTA ,TAB.NUMNOTA ,TAB.DTNEG ,TAB.CODPARC ,TAB.NOMEPARC ,TAB.CODPARCTRANSP ,TAB.TRASNP ,TAB.VLROUTROSFRETE ,TAB.VLR_FRETE_NOTA ,TAB.FRETE_COBRADO ,TAB.VLR_FRETE_NOTA + TAB.VLROUTROSFRETE - TAB.FRETE_COBRADO AS DIF ,(ABS(TAB.VLR_FRETE_NOTA + TAB.VLROUTROSFRETE - TAB.FRETE_COBRADO) / (TAB.VLR_FRETE_NOTA +TAB.VLROUTROSFRETE))*100 AS ANALISEP FROM( SELECT CAB.NUNOTA, CAB.NUMNOTA, CAB.DTNEG, CAB.CODPARC, PAR.NOMEPARC, CAB.CODPARCTRANSP, (SELECT P.NOMEPARC FROM TGFPAR P WHERE CAB.CODPARCTRANSP = P.CODPARC) AS TRASNP, NVL(CAB.AD_VLROUTROSFRETE, 0) AS VLROUTROSFRETE, ( SELECT NVL(SUM(DIN.BASE),0) FROM TGFDIN DIN WHERE DIN.NUNOTA = CAB.NUNOTA AND DIN.CODINC = 3 AND DIN.CODIMP = 1 ) AS VLR_FRETE_NOTA, NVL(SUM(C.VLRNOTA), 0) AS FRETE_COBRADO FROM TGFCAB CAB INNER JOIN TGFPAR PAR ON PAR.CODPARC = CAB.CODPARC INNER JOIN TGFNCT NCT ON NCT.CHAVENFE = CAB.CHAVENFE INNER JOIN TGFCAB C ON C.NUNOTA = NCT.NUNOTA AND C.TIPMOV = 'C' WHERE CAB.TIPMOV = 'V' AND (CAB.CODEMP = 501 OR CAB.STATUSNFE <> 'D') AND ((CAB.TIPFRETE = 'S' AND CAB.VLRFRETE > 0) OR CAB.AD_VLROUTROSFRETE > 0) AND CAB.DTNEG >= :P_PERIODO.INI AND CAB.DTNEG <= :P_PERIODO.FIN AND CAB.CODTIPOPER IN (1100,1124) GROUP BY CAB.NUNOTA, CAB.NUMNOTA, CAB.DTNEG, CAB.CODPARC, PAR.NOMEPARC, CAB.CODPARCTRANSP, CAB.AD_VLROUTROSFRETE, CAB.CHAVENFE )TAB
